newsitem.title: INDIA: Tata IBM signs deal with India state firm.
newsitem.headline: Tata IBM signs deal with India state firm.

text.p: India's Tata IBM Ltd said it has signed an agreement with a government firm to promote information technology in the south Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.

Under the agreement Tata IBM will collaborate with Andhra Pradesh Technology Services Ltd to develop software, customise and train government departments, educational institutions and other agencies, the firm said on Friday.
Tata IBM, formerly called Tata Information Systems Ltd, is a 50:50 joint venture between America's International Business Machines Corp and India's biggest industrial group the Tatas.
